title: BlackLanturn Build 1.1.26
summary: Better title discovery, more reliable previews and easier BlackLanturn updates.

sections.heading: Easier updates
bullets: Installer 1.0.31 adds an Updates sidebar with your installed version, update checks, release notes and notification controls.
Release notes scroll with Up and Down. Update BlackLanturn keeps your complete setup automatically; Keep choices apply to reinstalling.

sections.heading: Better browsing
bullets: Choose genre is available in main Movies and Shows title options, including lower rows. It stays hidden while browsing episodes and other unrelated views.
More like this uses Recommendations first, with Similar as a fallback. Branded Next and Previous retain your title and browsing position.

sections.heading: More reliable previews
bullets: Valid Final Trailer, Red Band Trailer and TV installment labels are recognized while wrong-series checks stay active.
When the usual list has no suitable preview, one limited, cached YouTube lookup can find another. Previews remain excluded from YouTube watch history.

sections.heading: Keep your setup
bullets: Your authorizations, playback settings, watched and resume progress, sources, favourites and other saved data stay in place.
Included add-ons and tested patches update together. Other add-ons you installed are left alone. Close and reopen Kodi after updating.
